_notes: Everything the videos have used, so the agent reuses before inventing. Status: core (starter kit, build first), requested (invented by a script, not built yet), built, retired. Edit with tools/library.py, not by hand.

assets.name: Event hall
assets.description: A busy networking event: high tables, drinks, warm low light, crowd silhouettes.

assets.name: Drinks table
assets.description: Close corner of the event by the drinks. Two to three people fit comfortably.

assets.name: Stage talk
assets.description: Rows of seats facing a small stage with a speaker and a mic.

assets.name: Coffee shop
assets.description: A two-person table by a window, two cups.

assets.name: Coworking space
assets.description: Desks, laptops, plants, a whiteboard.

assets.name: Phone screen
assets.description: Full-frame phone UI for DMs, texts and profiles. Uses the dm_screen component.

assets.name: Event doorway
assets.description: The entrance to the event, with a lanyard table and the room glowing behind.

assets.name: Street at night
assets.description: Outside after the event: wet pavement, streetlights, walking home.

assets.name: Brand void
assets.description: Plain off-white background with the gold accent. For big statements and cards.

assets.name: Drink glass
assets.description: A stylised glass a character can hold, sip or put down.

assets.name: Phone
assets.description: A character's phone: check it, type, show the screen to camera.

assets.name: Freeze frame
assets.description: Everything stops mid-motion except the narrator's focus.

assets.name: Colour drain
assets.description: The wrong move: the frame drains to cold grey-blue and slows. Part of the locked visual grammar.

assets.name: Gold glow
assets.description: The right move: warm gold light spreads and colour floods back. Part of the locked visual grammar.

assets.name: Whip pan
assets.description: A fast blurred camera swing used as a transition.

assets.name: The answer door
assets.description: When someone tells you something about themselves, a small glowing door appears between you. Ignoring it shuts it, a follow-up opens it into their world.
assets.reuse: Any video about listening, follow-ups, curiosity or missed openings

assets.name: Glowing door
assets.description: A small wooden door, knee height next to a character, with a warm gold glow from the gap underneath. It rises from any surface, shrinks and shuts with a puff of smoke, or swings open onto a new set. A small painted icon on it shows what's behind it.
assets.reuse: The answer door metaphor, any 'opening' or opportunity moment

assets.name: Question cards
assets.description: Two speech bubbles held like playing cards, hand sized, marked with big numbers. One can glow gold, the other crumbles to dust.
assets.reuse: Ranking or comparing lines, first vs second, this vs that

assets.name: Loading spinner
assets.description: A floating grey loading spinner above a character's head, slowly turning, shown while they're bored or stalled.

assets.name: VHS rewind
assets.description: The whole frame scrubs backwards with VHS tracking lines and a slight colour wobble, then snaps back to normal at a chosen moment.
assets.reuse: Showing the do-over, 'let's try that again'

assets.name: Night kitchen lab
assets.description: A small home kitchen at 2am, lit by one warm lamp, the counter covered in test bottles, handwritten labels and a laptop. Feels like someone's first business.
assets.reuse: Any founder's origin story or side-project moment

assets.name: Interrogation room
assets.description: A dark police interview room with a metal table, two chairs, a swinging overhead lamp and an old tape recorder. Played for comedy, not menace.
assets.reuse: Asking too many questions, being grilled, awkward pressure

assets.name: Ping-pong table
assets.description: A full-size ping-pong table with paddles and a ball that can glow gold, built so the interview table or any table can flip into it.
assets.reuse: Back-and-forth conversation, give and take, trading

assets.name: Study scale grid
assets.description: A huge grid of tiny two-person tables seen from above, each one able to light up warm or go grey, with small tickets that can fly out of chosen tables.
assets.reuse: Showing the size and result of any study with many participants

assets.name: Question bubbles
assets.description: Speech bubbles that float up from conversations like balloons. Grey ones merge into a fog over the room, a gold one can drift to one person and be pocketed.
assets.reuse: Forgettable vs memorable lines, small talk, being remembered
